findings.user_goal: Operator discovers only documented commands; retired parser routes must reject.
findings.observation: Seven retired parser/help route families accepted but cannot execute.

findings.user_goal: Operator asks for legacy command help without reaching a misleading success route.
findings.observation: Legacy question-help and guided menu aliases looked supported.

findings.user_goal: Agent operator discovers how TCP and Fixed TCP Service Objects map to an allocated public endpoint.
findings.observation: Remote Service help omitted prerequisites and public port ownership.

findings.user_goal: Windows Agent operator follows the generated enrollment and synchronization guidance.
findings.observation: Generated guidance used retired nouns or non-executable synchronization wording.

findings.user_goal: Unprivileged operator checks installed version and receives a truthful permission recovery.
findings.observation: Version display could hide unreadable install state.

findings.user_goal: Operator discovers a complete policy creation path from contextual help.
findings.observation: Remote, Internet and AI Access parent help omitted actionable rule construction.

findings.user_goal: Operator finds full nested enrollment/certificate/credential options without undocumented guesses.
findings.observation: Nested public help was incomplete for enrollment, certificates and credentials.

findings.user_goal: Server operator inspects current hostname, bootstrap and installer settings read-only.
findings.observation: System status did not reveal all server settings required for inspection.

findings.user_goal: Operator can follow update recovery text using executable commands and current terms.
findings.observation: Update/rollback recovery text contained obsolete client terminology.
